[P3] Account for the changed contract-test expectations

Rule 5, “A bug fix starts with a failing test,” item 4 requires changes to existing test expectations to list the affected tests and reasons in the PR description. These additions and the corresponding target/module additions change expectations in existing tests, including `test_templates_map_every_otel_requirement` and `test_handler_modules_are_exactly_the_expected_set`. The description documents only the workflow-contract test edit, leaving these expectation changes without the required accounting. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and record the affected tests and reasons alongside the agreed coverage scope.
